name: atlas-media-studio
description: Turns a brief into finished images, video, narration and music by orchestrating 300+ generation models on Atlas Cloud.

displayDescription.en: Orchestrates 300+ generation models to take a one-line brief all the way to a finished cut: storyboard, footage, narration, music and edit. Quotes the cost before each run and picks the cheapest model that still meets the quality bar.
displayDescription.zh: 调度平台上三百多个模型，把一句需求做成成片：写分镜、生成画面、配音配乐、剪成视频，生成前先报价。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我做一条 15 秒的产品宣传视频
defaultInitPrompt.en: Make me a 15-second product promo video

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一条 15 秒的产品宣传视频

quickPrompts.zh: 用分镜的方式生成一组风格统一的图
